edition.locus: Documenta Catholica Omnia Canones GR (sources/canones_GR.pdf), p. 2, Canon ς´

source_text: Ἀπηγγέλθη δέ τι ἡμῖν καὶ ἄπιστον ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ ὑμῶν γενόμενον, πάντως που ὑπὸ ἀπίστων καὶ ἀσεβῶν καὶ μὴ εἰδότων μηδὲ ὄνομα Κυρίου· ὅτι ἄρα εἰς τοσοῦτόν τινες ὠμότητος καὶ ἀπανθρωπίας προεχώρησαν, ὥστε τινὰς τοὺς διαφυγόντας αἰχμαλώτους βίᾳ κατέχειν. Ἀποστείλατέ τινας εἰς τὴν χώραν, μὴ καὶ σκηπτοὶ πέσωσιν ἐπὶ τοὺς τὰ τοιαῦτα πράσσοντας.
orientation: Gregory has heard that some in the bishop's district held escaped captives by force, and he urges that people be sent there.
pass_a_gloss: Something unbelievable was reported to us as having happened in your country, surely somehow by unbelievers and impious and not knowing even the name of the Lord: that some advanced to such a degree of cruelty and inhumanity as to hold by force some captives who had escaped. Send some into the country, lest thunderbolts also fall on those doing such things.

choices.why: Keeps the play on the same word.
καί is only an intensifier and does not change the sense; σκηπτοί are thunderbolts.

pass_b_english: Something beyond belief has also been reported to us as having happened in your district—surely the work of unbelievers and impious people who do not know even the name of the Lord: that some have gone so far in cruelty and inhumanity as to hold by force certain captives who had escaped. Send some people into the district, lest thunderbolts fall on those who do such things.
notes: Rubric left out (editorial). The play on ἄπιστον / ἀπίστων ('unbelievable' / 'unbelievers') is kept as 'beyond belief' / 'unbelievers'. πάντως που ('surely, I suppose') is ironic: such things could only be expected of unbelievers. χώρα rendered 'district' both times. Κυρίου = the Lord (God), capitalised. σκηπτοί = thunderbolts; not a Scripture citation. Correction βία → βίᾳ follows the source note.
